scenario.zh: 提供一封可疑邮件样本，Ocean 分析其中的钓鱼特征并标记风险点
scenario.en: Provide a suspicious email sample; Ocean analyzes phishing signals and flags risks

instruction.zh: 选一封可疑邮件进行检测
instruction.en: Pick a suspicious email to scan

output.zh: 检测到发件人域名仿冒和紧急语气
output.en: Detected spoofed sender domain and urgency tactics

input.zh:
发件人: cfo@comp4ny-holdings.com
主题: 紧急付款请求

请在今天下班前向以下账户转账，用于供应商预付款。这是机密项目，请勿与他人讨论。
input.en:
From: cfo@comp4ny-holdings.com
Subject: Urgent Payment Request

Please wire funds to the account below before end of day for vendor prepayment. Confidential project—do not discuss with others.

output.zh:
域名拼写异常：数字替代字母
制造紧迫感：今天截止
保密要求阻止核实
未经授权的付款请求
output.en:
Domain typo: number substitutes letter
Urgency pressure: today deadline
Secrecy prevents verification
Unauthorized payment request

output.zh: 识别伪造域名和虚假警告
output.en: Identified fake domain and false alert

input.zh:
发件人: security@emaiI-verify.com
主题: 账户即将停用

检测到异常登录。请回复确认身份，否则账户将在 24 小时内停用。
input.en:
From: security@emaiI-verify.com
Subject: Account Will Be Disabled

Unusual login detected. Reply to confirm your identity or account will be disabled in 24 hours.

output.zh:
发件人域名使用大写字母 I 伪装
创建虚假紧迫性
要求通过邮件回复敏感信息
未使用官方验证流程
output.en:
Sender domain uses capital I to mimic lowercase l
False urgency created
Requests sensitive info via email reply
Does not use official verification flow

output.zh: 发现新账户请求与历史不符
output.en: Found new account request inconsistent with history

input.zh:
发件人: accounts@trusted-vendor.com
主题: 银行账户更新

我们的银行账户已更改。请将未来所有付款发送至新账户。感谢您的配合。
input.en:
From: accounts@trusted-vendor.com
Subject: Bank Account Update

Our bank account has changed. Please send all future payments to the new account below. Thank you for your cooperation.

output.zh:
突然更改付款信息
缺少正式通知流程
未提供验证联系方式
常见供应商欺诈模式
output.en:
Sudden payment information change
Lacks formal notification process
No verification contact provided
Common vendor fraud pattern

instruction.zh: 检查发件人是否为合法联系人
instruction.en: Check if sender is legitimate contact

output.zh: 首次联系且要求敏感操作，风险升高
output.en: First contact requesting sensitive action—risk elevated

output.zh: 认证记录与声称发件人不符
output.en: Authentication records do not match claimed sender

output.zh: 用词与该联系人以往风格明显不同
output.en: Wording differs significantly from contact's usual style

instruction.zh: 查看此邮件的最终风险评估

output.zh: 多项特征符合 AI 生成钓鱼攻击模式，建议隔离并通知安全团队
output.en: Multiple signals match AI-generated phishing patterns—recommend quarantine and notify security team

takeaway.zh: 演示了 Ocean 如何检测邮件中的钓鱼特征；真实防护需在企业邮件网关部署并持续学习攻击模式
takeaway.en: Showed how Ocean detects phishing signals in email; real protection requires deployment at enterprise email gateway with continuous threat learning
